test_title: PYST 68: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially place from left to right in the blanks below to balance the given equation. 

8 _ 27 _ 9 _ 6 _ 5 = 0
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f1f11fbb4e091305a6b414e74c3aec25b8d519670a1f3bd65f5bd4eb1bdcd68.png] Given equation: 8 _ 27 _ 9 _ 6 _ 5 = 0 Option 1) + - + + Mathematical signs to sequentially place from left to right: ⇒ 8 + 27 - 9 + 6 + 5 = 0 ⇒ 46 - 9 = 0 ⇒ 37 = 0 **Option 2) +, ÷, −, −**
